title: Podiatrists
description: Diagnose and treat diseases and deformities of the human foot.

tasks.text: Treat bone, muscle, and joint disorders affecting the feet and ankles.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Chronic disease management needs clinical judgment

tasks.text: Diagnose diseases and deformities of the foot using medical histories, physical examinations, x-rays, and laboratory test results.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Image interpretation assists; radiologist owns diagnosis

dwas.name: Analyze test data or images to inform diagnosis or treatment.

tasks.text: Advise patients about treatments and foot care techniques necessary for prevention of future problems.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Preventive advice needs patient-specific clinical judgment

dwas.name: Advise patients on preventive care techniques.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Prescribe medications, corrective devices, physical therapy, or surgery.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Device prescription needs clinical assessment and accountability

dwas.name: Prescribe assistive medical devices or related treatments.

tasks.text: Surgically treat conditions such as corns, calluses, ingrown nails, tumors, shortened tendons, bunions, cysts, or abscesses.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Surgery is physical and high-accountability

dwas.name: Operate on patients to treat conditions.

tasks.text: Refer patients to physicians when symptoms indicative of systemic disorders, such as arthritis or diabetes, are observed in feet and legs.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Clinical referral judgment needs licensed human accountability

dwas.name: Refer patients to other healthcare practitioners or health resources.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Medical device fabrication is physical manufacturing

dwas.name: Adjust prostheses or other assistive devices.

tasks.text: Correct deformities by means of plaster casts and strapping.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Chronic disease management needs clinical judgment

tasks.text: Perform administrative duties, such as hiring employees, ordering supplies, or keeping records.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Facility records need human verification and compliance

tasks.text: Educate the public about the benefits of foot care through techniques such as speaking engagements, advertising, and other forums.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Health messaging drafted by AI; public delivery human

dwas.name: Communicate health and wellness information to the public.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Treat deformities using mechanical methods, such as whirlpool or paraffin baths, and electrical methods, such as short wave and low voltage currents.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Alternative procedures are hands-on

dwas.name: Treat patients using alternative medical procedures.
